ruoPeptide.question: What does the "Research Use Only" (RUO) label actually restrict?
ruoPeptide.answer: It restricts the compound to laboratory and scientific research settings only — it is not intended for human or animal consumption, diagnosis, or treatment. Every peptide Certified Aminos lists is manufactured and sold under that classification, and none of them have been reviewed by the FDA for use outside a research context.

researchGradePurity.question: What qualifies a peptide as "research-grade"?
researchGradePurity.answer: Research-grade status comes from documented testing, not a marketing claim: the batch is run through HPLC and mass spectrometry to confirm both purity (generally 98%+) and molecular identity, and that data ships with the product rather than being estimated after the fact. It's prepared for bench use, not clinical dosing.

coaContents.question: What data does a peptide's Certificate of Analysis need to show?
coaContents.answer: A usable COA states the lot number, the HPLC-measured purity percentage, mass-spec confirmation of molecular weight, and the test date. Before trusting it, check that the lot number printed on the document matches the one on your vial — that's what ties the paperwork to the physical sample in your hand.

massSpecIdentity.question: Why run both mass spectrometry and HPLC instead of just one test?
massSpecIdentity.answer: They check different things: mass spec confirms the compound's molecular weight, while HPLC isolates it from related impurities to establish purity. Neither test alone tells the full story, which is why a credible batch report includes both rather than leaning on a single number.

assayDevelopment.question: What role do research peptides play in lab study design?
assayDevelopment.answer: They function as a controlled reagent — a purity-verified input researchers can test against a defined protocol in cellular, biochemical, or pharmacological work. What makes results comparable from one batch to the next is consistency, which is exactly what COA documentation is meant to establish.

commonImpurities.question: What kinds of impurities show up in synthetic peptide batches?
commonImpurities.answer: The usual suspects are truncated sequences left over from incomplete synthesis cycles, residual solvent, and trace related-compound by-products. HPLC testing exists specifically to catch and measure these rather than take a clean batch on faith.

receptorBindingStudies.question: Why does peptide purity matter for receptor-binding assays specifically?
receptorBindingStudies.answer: In a binding assay, an impure sample can produce results driven by a contaminant rather than the compound under study. Confirmed identity and measured purity are what let a researcher trust that an observed interaction reflects the peptide itself.

vendorQuestions.question: What should I ask a peptide supplier before ordering from them?
vendorQuestions.answer: Four questions cover most of it: Is every batch independently tested? Can I see the COA before I buy? What purity threshold do you guarantee? How is the order shipped and stored in transit? A supplier willing to answer all four with documentation, not just a claim on the label, is worth trusting more than one that isn't.

supplierLegitimacy.question: How do I tell a legitimate research peptide supplier from one that isn't?
supplierLegitimacy.answer: Third-party (not just in-house) batch testing, a COA available before purchase, honest research-use-only labeling, and real, findable company information are the four signals worth checking. If what's advertised on the page matches what the documentation actually shows, that consistency is the strongest indicator you're dealing with a legitimate supplier.

whatSetsUsApart.description: Certified Aminos specializes in high-purity synthetic peptides engineered specifically for research laboratory environments. Our commitment to analytical rigor and documentation transparency addresses the core needs of scientific research:

purityStandards.title: Documented Purity Thresholds
purityStandards.description: Every batch is held to a documented purity threshold before it is listed, rather than an unverified marketing claim.

massSpecValidation.title: Dual-Method Identity Testing
massSpecValidation.description: Molecular identity is confirmed by mass spectrometry alongside HPLC purity testing, not by either method alone.

comprehensiveDocs.title: Batch-Level Paper Trail
comprehensiveDocs.description: A batch-specific certificate of analysis is available for every product, so purity and identity can be checked independently.

researchOnly.title: Strictly Research-Use Labeling
researchOnly.description: Certified Aminos markets exclusively to the research community, with RUO and not-for-human-consumption labeling kept visible, not buried in fine print.

hplcPurity.title: Chromatography-Confirmed Purity
hplcPurity.description: High-performance liquid chromatography testing confirms the purity percentage published for every batch, rather than an assumed or estimated figure.

msIdentity.title: Mass Spec Cross-Check
msIdentity.description: Mass spectrometry independently confirms molecular weight and identity, cross-checking the HPLC purity result against the compound itself.

coaDocumentation.title: COA On Every Order
coaDocumentation.description: Every order is backed by a batch-specific certificate of analysis, available to review so purity and identity claims can be verified rather than taken on faith.

trustBadges.subtitle: USA-Manufactured. Third-Party Verified.
trustBadges.description: Every compound in the Certified Aminos catalog is synthesized to a documented purity standard and verified before it's listed — not estimated, and not left to a marketing claim.

purity.title: 99.1%+ Measured Purity
purity.description: Each batch is independently tested by HPLC to confirm purity above 99.1%, with results published on the batch's certificate of analysis rather than kept in-house.

stability.title: Freeze-Dried for Stability
stability.description: Compounds are vacuum-lyophilized to protect molecular structure over time, so integrity holds up through shipping, handling, and long-term cold storage.

dosing.title: Milligram-Accurate Fill
dosing.description: Vials are formulated to a precise milligram content per unit, confirmed by mass spectrometry, so researchers can calculate concentrations accurately for their protocol.

availablePeptides.question: What's in the Certified Aminos catalog?
availablePeptides.answer: A curated, research-use-only lineup for lab study — BPC-157, TB-500, Semaglutide, Tirzepatide, Ipamorelin, CJC-1295, PT-141, Melanotan II, GHK-Cu, Thymosin Alpha-1, Epithalon, Selank, Semax, and other related compounds. Every listing shows live stock status, the vial sizes on offer, and a link to that batch's certificate of analysis.

purityQualityTested.question: Is every product here purity-tested before it's sold?
purityQualityTested.answer: Yes — third-party HPLC and mass spectrometry testing happens before a batch is ever listed, and the resulting COA is posted at or before checkout, not after the sale.

standardPurityLevels.question: What purity level should I expect from a research peptide?
standardPurityLevels.answer: 98% or higher is the baseline among suppliers who actually test their product, and a lot of premium compounds land at 99%. What matters is that HPLC confirms the number rather than the listing just asserting it — check the COA rather than take the percentage at face value.

interpretCoa.question: How do I read a certificate of analysis?
interpretCoa.answer: Look for the batch number, the HPLC purity reading, mass-spec confirmation of molecular weight, and the date it was tested. Cross-check that batch number against the one printed on your vial — if they match, you know the COA actually belongs to what's in your hand.

customSynthesis.question: Can you synthesize a peptide to a custom spec?
customSynthesis.answer: Sometimes, depending on the sequence, quantity, and how much lead time you can give. Reach out through support with your requirement before assuming it's off the shelf — we'll confirm feasibility, pricing, and turnaround directly.

shippingDamage.question: Can shipping conditions damage a peptide?
shippingDamage.answer: Yes — heat, repeated freeze-thaw cycling, and extended light exposure all degrade integrity. Orders ship in cold-chain packaging suited to the compound, but move vials into proper storage as soon as they arrive rather than leaving them on a counter.

orderDocumentation.question: What paperwork ships with an order?
orderDocumentation.answer: An invoice and a link to that batch's certificate of analysis, every time. Institutional buyers who need consolidated invoicing for recurring or PO-based purchasing can set up a wholesale account instead of ordering one-off.

orderQuantities.question: Can I buy in bulk or does every order come as a single vial?
orderQuantities.answer: Most compounds list multiple vial sizes, and a number of them have bundle or bulk pricing built in for larger studies. Check the individual product listing — sizes and quantity pricing are shown right there.

coaBeforeOrdering.question: Can I see the COA before I buy, not just after?
coaBeforeOrdering.answer: Yes — it's linked straight from the product page, so you can check purity, batch number, and method before you commit rather than finding out what you got after it ships.

findSpecificPeptides.question: What's the fastest way to find a specific compound?
findSpecificPeptides.answer: Search by name directly, or browse by category — GLP-1, tissue repair, cognitive research, and so on. Stacking a stock-status filter on top narrows it further to what's actually available right now.

productPageInfo.question: What's actually on a product page?
productPageInfo.answer: Compound name, the vial sizes we carry, current price, live stock status, and a linked COA for that batch.

manufacturedInUsa.question: Is everything sourced and tested domestically?
manufacturedInUsa.answer: Certified Aminos operates and tests within the USA, with every batch cleared domestically before it's listed. If you need country-of-origin or testing specifics for a particular compound, ask and we'll confirm, or check the linked COA.

researchUseOnlyMeaning.question: What exactly does "Research Use Only" mean here?
researchUseOnlyMeaning.answer: It means the compound is sold strictly for laboratory and scientific research — not for human or animal consumption, diagnosis, or treatment. RUO products haven't been reviewed by the FDA for safety or efficacy outside that context, and we don't market them as if they had.

nonResearchUse.question: Can these be used for anything other than lab research?
nonResearchUse.answer: No. Everything in the Certified Aminos catalog is labeled Research Use Only — not intended, tested, or cleared for human consumption, self-administration, or any clinical application. Laboratory research is the only intended use.

fdaApproval.question: Are any of these FDA-approved?
fdaApproval.answer: No. RUO peptides aren't approved for human use and we don't market them as drugs, supplements, or cosmetics — they're sold and labeled strictly as research chemicals.

privacyPolicy.metaDescription: See how Certified Aminos collects, uses, and safeguards personal data across ordering, account access, and research-use compliance on our website.

Continuing to use the website means you're accepting the practices outlined below.

privacyPolicy.section1Item2Text: Login credentials, past orders, and saved account preferences.
privacyPolicy.section1Item3Text: Billing information, handled securely through vetted third-party payment processors.
privacyPolicy.section1Item4Text: IP address, browser and device type, pages viewed, and general interaction patterns on the site.
privacyPolicy.section1Item5Text: Small tracking technologies that help us improve site performance, remember preferences, and personalize content.

privacyPolicy.section2Item3: Refine and troubleshoot the website's functionality and overall experience.

privacyPolicy.section3Item3Text: To investigate fraud, uphold our terms, or protect the safety of our users and business.
privacyPolicy.section3Item4Text: Pages on our site may link elsewhere; we don't control and aren't responsible for how those third-party sites handle your data.
privacyPolicy.section4Text1: We rely on encryption, access controls, and secured servers to keep your personal information safe from unauthorized access.
privacyPolicy.section4Text2: That said, no online system offers a perfect guarantee. Using our site means accepting the inherent risk that comes with transmitting data over the internet.
privacyPolicy.section5Item1: Review, update, or correct the personal data we hold about you.
privacyPolicy.section5Item2: Ask us to permanently delete your information from our systems.
privacyPolicy.section5Item3: Opt out of receiving marketing or promotional messages.
privacyPolicy.section5Item4: Limit or object to how we process your data.
privacyPolicy.section5ContactText: To act on any of these rights, reach out to:

privacyPolicy.section6Item1: It is not designed or approved for human or veterinary use.
privacyPolicy.section6Item2: It carries no intended diagnostic, therapeutic, or treatment purpose.
privacyPolicy.section6Item3: Buyers alone are responsible for handling products in line with applicable laws and safety standards.

refundPolicy.metaDescription: Certified Aminos' Refund Policy covers eligibility windows, non-refundable items, damaged orders, and the steps for requesting a refund on research products.
refundPolicy.intro: Certified Aminos stands behind the research peptides, compounds, and biochemical products we ship. Before placing an order, take a moment to read this Refund Policy so you know exactly what to expect if something needs to be returned or refunded.
refundPolicy.section1Text: This policy lays out when a refund or exchange applies to an order. Every item Certified Aminos sells is intended strictly for research use — never for human or veterinary use, diagnosis, or treatment — and refunds exist to keep customers satisfied without compromising the integrity of the products themselves.
refundPolicy.section2Intro: An order qualifies for a refund or exchange only when it meets all of the following:
refundPolicy.section2Item1: The item is still sealed, unused, and in its original packaging.
refundPolicy.section2Item2: You submit the request within 7 calendar days of delivery.
refundPolicy.section2Item3: You can provide your order number along with proof of purchase.
refundPolicy.section2Important: Important: given how sensitive and time-limited research peptides are, we're unable to accept returns once a product has been opened or partially used.
refundPolicy.section3Intro: A refund won't be issued for:
refundPolicy.section3Item1: Items purchased through a promotional campaign or affiliate discount.
refundPolicy.section3Item2: Products that have already been opened or used in any way.
refundPolicy.section3Item3: Products past their expiration date or mishandled after delivery.
refundPolicy.section3Item4: Bulk or custom orders explicitly marked as final sale.
refundPolicy.section4Intro: Follow these steps to start a refund request:
refundPolicy.section4Item1: Reach our support team at <email>support@certified-aminos.com</email>, including your order number and the reason for the request.
refundPolicy.section4Item2: Send photos of the item and its packaging if we ask for them.
refundPolicy.section4Item3: We'll review the request and get back to you with a decision within 3–5 business days.
refundPolicy.section4Item4: Approved refunds go back to your original payment method, or to store credit, whichever you prefer.
refundPolicy.section4Item5: Once approved, expect the funds to post within 10 business days.
refundPolicy.section4Tip: Tip: double-check your order before checking out — once a research-use product is opened, it can't be resold, so returns after that point aren't possible.
refundPolicy.section5Item1: Return shipping is on the customer unless the issue traces back to a shipping mistake or product damage on our end.
refundPolicy.section5Item2: Package returns securely to prevent damage in transit.
refundPolicy.section5Item3: Temperature-sensitive items need appropriate handling during return shipping to stay viable.
refundPolicy.section6Intro: Received something damaged or wrong? Get in touch right away:
refundPolicy.section6Text: We'll set up a free replacement or refund once the issue is confirmed. Please flag any problem within 48 hours of delivery.
refundPolicy.section7Item1: All items are sold strictly for laboratory and research use. Refund eligibility is void if a product is used for any human or veterinary purpose.
refundPolicy.section7Item2: Every refund request is subject to review and is granted at our discretion, consistent with applicable law.
refundPolicy.section7Item3: Certified Aminos may revise this Refund Policy at any time without prior notice.

certificates.metaTitle: Certificate of 99% Purity Peptides | Lab-Tested COA Reports
certificates.metaDescription: View certified lab reports for 99% purity peptides. Transparent COA documents ensuring quality, accuracy, and trusted research-grade standards.
certificates.title: Certificates of Analysis
certificates.description: Transparency is not optional. We verify every batch through independent, third-party US laboratories using high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) and mass spectrometry (MS).
certificates.emptyLibrary: COA documents are being added for our current catalogue. Check back soon, or contact us for a specific batch's Certificate of Analysis.
certificates.processText1: Every raw material we receive undergoes rigorous High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) prior to compounding. This analytical technique separates, identifies, and quantifies each component in a mixture, ensuring absolute sequence accuracy.
certificates.processText2: Following synthesis and lyophilization, random samples from the finished batch are submitted to independent third-party laboratories. They perform secondary HPLC alongside Mass Spectrometry (MS) to verify that the molecular weight perfectly matches the target peptide structure and that purity exceeds our 99% baseline standard.
certificates.ctaText: Learn more about why rigorous independent testing is the only way to guarantee reproducible research results.

trustworthySupplier.question: How do you tell a trustworthy peptide supplier from one that just says the right things?
trustworthySupplier.answer: The paperwork tells the real story — a per-lot certificate of analysis, raw-material sourcing you can actually trace, and manufacturing steps that hold up to outside verification. At Certified Aminos that documentation isn't a premium add-on; it's the minimum bar, because a research result is only as good as your certainty about what compound you were actually testing.

analyticalQuality.question: What does Certified Aminos actually do to guarantee analytical quality?
analyticalQuality.answer: Raw batches get checked against purity and identity specs before production even starts, then re-verified after synthesis with HPLC and mass spectrometry. Two independent checkpoints, not one — so the compound that ships matches what the label claims.

laboratoryResearchOnly.question: Is everything you sell strictly for lab use?
laboratoryResearchOnly.answer: Correct. Every Certified Aminos product is a synthetic compound made exclusively for laboratory and research applications — none of it is manufactured, labeled, or sold for human or animal use, and none of it has FDA review behind any diagnostic, therapeutic, or preventive claim.

documentationProvided.question: What paperwork actually comes with an order?
documentationProvided.answer: Batch-specific documentation on request — a certificate of analysis covering purity, identity, and the method used to test it. Pull that documentation before you run anything, so your results trace back to a verified compound and lot rather than an assumption.

aboutHero.subtitle: Certified Aminos supplies synthetic research peptides to laboratories and research teams across the US. The company was founded on a simple premise: every compound leaving our facility should be backed by documentation a researcher can independently check — measured purity, confirmed identity, and a research-use-only classification that applies to every single batch, not just the first one. We're not a pharmacy, and nothing here is intended for human or animal use. To us, "research-grade" describes what a lab actually did to a compound, not just a phrase printed on a label.

statements.researchOnly: Everything sold through Certified Aminos is a synthetic research peptide, intended strictly for laboratory research use.

statements.notForDiagnosisTreatment: Not for diagnosis, treatment, prevention, mitigation, or cure of any disease or condition, and not intended for administration of any kind.
statements.notFdaApproved: Products have not been evaluated or approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

missionPhilosophyJourney.title: Principles & Values
missionPhilosophyJourney.card1Text: One purity and identity spec applies to every batch — scale or turnaround time doesn't earn an exception.
missionPhilosophyJourney.card2Text: Documentation goes out with the order by default, not only when someone thinks to ask for it.
missionPhilosophyJourney.card3Text: Compliance doesn't get bolted on after the fact here — it's part of how a batch gets made in the first place. Every peptide we supply is manufactured against a defined purity and identity spec, checked by independent analytical testing, and comes with documentation researchers can request before they place an order, not after. We put our compliance position in plain language instead of fine print, because a supplier that actually trusts its own quality control has no reason to hide how that control works. Transparency isn't a tagline for us — it's just how the operation runs.

ourServices.card1Text: Certified Aminos supplies chemically pure synthetic research peptides for advanced life-science work, whether that's early-stage compound screening or an established lab protocol. Every single batch gets purity and identity confirmation — not a spot-check sample here and there.
ourServices.card2Text1: Laboratory research is the only intended use for anything we sell. From how a product is described to how it's fulfilled, we never market, label, or position our peptides for human or animal use at any point.
ourServices.card2Text2: Nobody on our team gives medical advice, dosing guidance, or usage recommendations — that's simply not what we do.
